lines.t: I hear His voice calling me home
My spirit alive, my heart set free
He stands before me with arms wide open
A longing fulfilled, anticipation complete
The wait is over, joy beyond words
As we run into light that will never fade
We are the chosen and the called
Hearts awakened, set apart
Through the door that is now closed behind
We are gathered one by one in Emma's praise
Clothed in white, bound by love and perfect peace
Mountains bow and valleys rise
The shadows of sorrow fall away
Standing new in a world made bright
All things forgotten in the warmth of His face
Every tear He gently removes
We dwell in a joy never-ending
But memory lingers for those left behind
Resisting the shepherd's gentle call
Walking the long and narrow place
Refined through storms and silent years
If you reach maturity in the harvest time
Awaiting the day when they're gathered too
Now I am gathered in His embrace Surrounded by light, beholding His grace
He wipes away all that was lost I rest in hope and I'm finally home
Thank you.
Thank you.
